end
local blocks = castle()

local state -- everything the game remembers; a reset replaces it
local function fresh()
  return { score = 0, pigs = { pig_roof = true, pig_mid = true }, goal = false, shots = {}, nshot = 0, aim = nil,
    g = G_NORMAL, gname = "normal", well = false, status = "Pull the stone back and let go", pending = nil }
end
state = fresh()

local SLING = { 96, 392 } -- where the stone rests; pulled back, up to PULL away
local PULL, POWER, PIPS, BAND = 72, 11, 16, 6

local grabbable = {} -- ids a drag may take; rebuilt each view

local function loose(id, x, y, drawing_, collider, mat, extra)
  grabbable[id] = true
  local e = { id = id, pos = { x, y }, drawing = drawing_, collider = collider, loose = mat }
  for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do e[k] = v end
  return e
end

-- ── entities ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function build()
  grabbable = {}
  local out = {}
  local function add(e) out[#out + 1] = e end
  add({ id = "sky", pos = { 0, 0 }, drawing = sky() })
  -- contact shadows: soft dark ellipses on the ground under the structures
  add({ id = "shadow", pos = { 405, FY - 7 }, drawing = memo("shadow", function()
    return drawing(190, 14, { { path = ellipse(95, 7, 95, 6), fill = "#00000030" }, { path = ellipse(95, 7, 70, 4.5), fill = "#00000040" } })
  end) })
  add({ id = "shadow2", pos = { 580, FY - 41 }, drawing = memo("shadow2", function()
    return drawing(250, 5, { { path = ellipse(125, 2.5, 125, 2.5), fill = "#00000040" } })
  end) })
  -- floor, plinth, shelf and ramp: fixed colliders
  add({ id = "floor", pos = { 0, FY }, drawing = ground(), collider = { rect = { W, H - FY } } })
  add({ id = "wall:t", pos = { 0, -20 }, drawing = invisible(W, 20), collider = { rect = { W, 20 } } }) -- flipped gravity piles up here
  add({ id = "wall:l", pos = { -20, 0 }, drawing = invisible(20, H), collider = { rect = { 20, H } } })
  add({ id = "wall:r", pos = { W, 0 }, drawing = invisible(20, H), collider = { rect = { 20, H } } })
  add({ id = "plinth", pos = { 82, 424 }, drawing = slab(28, 56, "#6b5b4a", "#9a8670", "#3f3428"), collider = { rect = { 28, 56 } } })
  add({ id = "shelf", pos = { 580, 440 }, drawing = slab(240, 40, "#5b6075", "#8d93a6", "#3a3e50"), collider = { rect = { 240, 40 } } })
  local RS, RW = 18, 4.5
  for i = 0, RS - 1 do -- a slope in fine steps, the box colliders being axis-aligned
    local top = 440 + (i + 1) * (FY - 440 - 2) / RS
    add({ id = "ramp" .. i, pos = { 820 + RW * i, top }, drawing = slab(RW + 0.5, FY - top, "#5b6075", "#8d93a6", "#3a3e50", "#5b6075"),
      collider = { rect = { RW, FY - top } } })
  end
  add({ id = "bucket:wall", pos = { 948, 420 }, drawing = slab(10, 60, "#7a6a55", "#a89478", "#4a3f30"), collider = { rect = { 10, 60 } } })
  -- the bucket's inside lights up when the marble lands
  add({ id = "bucket", pos = { 900, 452 }, drawing = memo("bucket" .. tostring(state.goal), function()
    local c = state.goal and C.lit or "#4a4033"
    return drawing(48, 28, { { path = rectp(0, 0, 48, 28), fill = c .. (state.goal and "" or "55") },
      { path = rectp(0, 24, 48, 4), fill = state.goal and "#fff6b0" or "#2a2118" } })
  end), sensor = { rect = { 48, 28 } } })
  if state.goal then
    add({ id = "glow", pos = { 870, 400 }, drawing = memo("glow", function()
      return drawing(110, 90, { { path = ellipse(55, 45, 55, 45), fill = "#ffe06622" }, { path = ellipse(55, 50, 38, 32), fill = "#ffe06633" },
        { path = ellipse(55, 56, 22, 18), fill = "#fff6b055" } })
    end) })
  end
  add({ id = "goal", pos = { 906, 452 }, drawing = invisible(40, 28), sensor = { rect = { 40, 28 } } })
  -- the kill zone along the ground where the castle stands: a pig that reaches it is down
  add({ id = "killzone", pos = { 380, FY - 18 }, drawing = invisible(240, 18), sensor = { rect = { 240, 18 } } })

  if state.flash then add({ id = "flash", pos = { 0, 0 }, drawing = memo("flash", function() return drawing(W, H, { { path = rectp(0, 0, W, H), fill = "#ffffff1c" } }) end) }) end
  -- the sling: two posts and the stone in it (not a body: it is moved by hand with `set`)
  add({ id = "sling", pos = { 84, 372 }, drawing = memo("sling", function()
    return drawing(30, 52, { { path = rectp(10, 18, 8, 34), fill = "#5a3b22" }, { path = rectp(2, 6, 7, 20), fill = "#7a5230" },
      { path = rectp(19, 6, 7, 20), fill = "#7a5230" } })
  end) })
  for i = 1, BAND do add({ id = "band" .. i, pos = { -40, -40 }, drawing = memo("bandpip", function() return drawing(5, 5, { { path = disc(2.5, 2.5, 2.5), fill = "#d9b07a" } }) end) }) end
  for i = 1, PIPS do add({ id = "arc" .. i, pos = { -40, -40 }, drawing = memo("arcpip" .. (i % 3), function()
    return drawing(6, 6, { { path = disc(3, 3, 3 - (i % 3) * 0.4), fill = "#ffffffcc" } })
  end) }) end
  add({ id = "ammo", pos = { SLING[1] - 11, SLING[2] - 11 }, drawing = ball(11, "#9aa0b3", "#d9deee", "#5b6075") })

  -- the castle and dominoes: loose bodies of mixed material
  for _, k in ipairs(blocks) do
    local kd = KIND[k.kind]
    add(loose(N(k.name), k.x, k.y, slab(k.w, k.h, kd.base, kd.hi, kd.lo, kd.edge), { rect = { k.w, k.h } }, kd.mat))
  end
  -- pigs: scored when they fall
  local PIGM = { bounce = 0.35, friction = 0.02, grip = 0.5, density = 0.9 }
  if state.pigs.pig_roof then add(loose(N("pig_roof"), 478, 256 - 14, pig(14), { circle = 14, at = { 14, 14 } }, PIGM)) end
  if state.pigs.pig_mid then add(loose(N("pig_mid"), 482, 326 - 24, pig(12), { circle = 12, at = { 12, 12 } }, PIGM)) end
  -- the marble waiting on a post at the shelf's edge, where the hammer will strike it
  add({ id = "post", pos = { 788, 400 }, drawing = slab(12, 40, "#7a6a55", "#a89478", "#4a3f30"), collider = { rect = { 12, 40 } } })
  add(loose(N("marble"), 784, 380, ball(10, "#6fa8ff", "#d6e6ff", "#2a4a8a"), { circle = 10, at = { 10, 10 } },
    { bounce = 0.3, friction = 0.01, grip = 0.6, density = 0.5 }))
  -- the pendulum: a chain of small links on rope joints, ending in an iron ball
  local ax, ay, LINKS = 390, 24, 9
  for i = 0, LINKS - 1 do
    add(loose(N("link" .. i), ax - 7, ay + 26 * (i + 1) - 7, ball(7, "#7d8497", "#dfe3f0", "#3d4152"), { circle = 7, at = { 7, 7 } },
      { bounce = 0.1, friction = 0.05, grip = 0.1, density = 3 }))
  end
  add(loose(N("bob"), ax - 22, ay + 26 * (LINKS + 1) - 22, ball(22, "#4a4f63", "#9aa0b8", "#1f2230"), { circle = 22, at = { 22, 22 } },
    { bounce = 0.2, friction = 0.03, grip = 0.3, density = 4 }))
  add({ id = "anchor", pos = { ax - 8, ay - 8 }, drawing = ball(8, "#d9b07a", "#fff3d0", "#7a5230") })
  -- the seesaw: a plank on a pin joint, centred on a fulcrum
  add({ id = "fulcrum", pos = { 250, FY - 22 }, drawing = memo("fulcrum", function()
    return drawing(40, 22, { { path = { { "move", 20, 0 }, { "line", 40, 22 }, { "line", 0, 22 }, { "close" } }, fill = "#7a6a55" } })
  end) })
  add(loose(N("seesaw"), 190, FY - 22 - 12, slab(160, 10, "#c58b4e", "#e8b27a", "#8a5a2c"), { rect = { 160, 10 } },
    { bounce = 0.1, friction = 0.02, grip = 0.8, density = 1 }))
  -- the shots fired so far
  for _, s in ipairs(state.shots) do
    add(loose(s, state[s].x - 11, state[s].y - 11, ball(11, "#9aa0b3", "#d9deee", "#5b6075"), { circle = 11, at = { 11, 11 } },
      { bounce = 0.1, friction = 0.02, grip = 0.6, density = 14 }))
  end
  return out
end

local function joints()
  local j, LINKS = {}, 9
  local function rope(id, a, b, b_at, length)
    j[#j + 1] = { id = id, kind = "rope", a = a, a_at = { 7, 7 }, b = b, b_at = b_at, length = length }
  end
  rope("chain0", N("link0"), nil, { 390, 24 }, 26)
  for i = 1, LINKS - 1 do rope("chain" .. i, N("link" .. i), N("link" .. (i - 1)), { 7, 7 }, 26) end
  j[#j + 1] = { id = "chainbob", kind = "rope", a = N("bob"), a_at = { 22, 22 }, b = N("link" .. (LINKS - 1)), b_at = { 7, 7 }, length = 26 }
  j[#j + 1] = { id = "seesaw", kind = "pin", a = N("seesaw"), a_at = { 80, 5 }, b_at = { 270, FY - 22 - 7 }, limits = { -12, 12 } }
  return j
end

-- ── interaction ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function arc_from(px, py, vx, vy)
  local g = state.g[2]
  local pts = {}
  for i = 1, PIPS do
    local t = 0.07 * i
    pts[i] = { px + vx * t, py + vy * t + 0.5 * g * t * t }
  end
  return pts
end

local function show_aim(px, py)
  local w = world("lab")
  local vx, vy = (SLING[1] - px) * POWER, (SLING[2] - py) * POWER
  w:set("ammo", { pos = { px - 11, py - 11 } })
  for i = 1, BAND do
    local t = i / (BAND + 1)
    w:set("band" .. i, { pos = { SLING[1] + (px - SLING[1]) * t - 2.5, SLING[2] + (py - SLING[2]) * t - 2.5 } })
  end
  for i, p in ipairs(arc_from(px, py, vx, vy)) do w:set("arc" .. i, { pos = { p[1] - 3, p[2] - 3 } }) end
end

local function hide_aim()
  local w = world("lab")
  state.aim = nil
  w:set("ammo", { pos = { SLING[1] - 11, SLING[2] - 11 } })
  for i = 1, BAND do w:set("band" .. i, { pos = { -40, -40 } }) end
  for i = 1, PIPS do w:set("arc" .. i, { pos = { -40, -40 } }) end
end

local function clamp_pull(x, y)
  local dx, dy = x - SLING[1], y - SLING[2]
  local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
  if d > PULL then dx, dy = dx / d * PULL, dy / d * PULL end
  return SLING[1] + dx, SLING[2] + dy
end

local function fire(px, py)
  local vx, vy = (SLING[1] - px) * POWER, (SLING[2] - py) * POWER
  state.nshot = state.nshot + 1
  local id = N("shot" .. state.nshot)
  state[id] = { x = px, y = py }
  state.shots[#state.shots + 1] = id
  if #state.shots > 3 then table.remove(state.shots, 1) end
  state.pending = { id = id, vx = vx, vy = vy }
  state.status = "Fire!"
  world("lab"):after(0.03, "launch")
end

local function on_drag(e)
  local w = world("lab")
  if e.phase == "start" then
    state.aim, state.held = nil, nil
    if e.shape == "ammo" then
      state.aim = true
    elseif grabbable[e.shape] then
      state.held = e.shape
    end
    return
  end
  if state.aim then
    local px, py = clamp_pull(e.x, e.y)
    if e.phase == "move" then
      show_aim(px, py)
    else
      local dx, dy = SLING[1] - px, SLING[2] - py
      hide_aim()
      if dx * dx + dy * dy > 144 then fire(px, py) end
    end
  elseif state.held then
    if e.phase == "end" then w:release(state.held) state.held = nil else w:grab(state.held, { e.x, e.y }) end
  end
end

local function on_zone(e)
  if e.phase ~= "enter" then return end
  local who = e.who
  if e.id == "killzone" then
    for _, name in ipairs({ "pig_roof", "pig_mid" }) do
      if who == N(name) and state.pigs[name] then
        state.pigs[name] = nil
        state.score = state.score + 100
        state.status = "Pig down!  +100"
      end
    end
  elseif e.id == "goal" and who == N("marble") and not state.goal then
    state.goal = true
    state.score = state.score + 500
    state.status = "GOAL!  +500"
  end
end

-- Lua cannot read where a hit landed, so a hard one flashes the whole sky instead.
local function on_hit(e)
  if e.speed > 450 and not state.flash then
    state.flash = true
    world("lab"):after(0.09, "unflash")
  end
end

local function on_timer(e)
  if e.name == "unflash" then state.flash = nil end
  if e.name == "launch" and state.pending then
    local p = state.pending
    state.pending = nil
    world("lab"):set(p.id, { velocity = { p.vx, p.vy } })
  end
end

local function reset()
  gen = gen + 1
  state = fresh()
  state.status = "Reset"
  world("lab"):cancel("launch")
end

local function cycle_gravity()
  if state.gname == "normal" then state.g, state.gname = G_MOON, "moon"
  elseif state.gname == "moon" then state.g, state.gname = G_FLIP, "flip"
  else state.g, state.gname = G_NORMAL, "normal" end
  state.status = "Gravity: " .. state.gname
end

local function button(id, label, on_click)
  return ui.button({
    id = id, px = 16, py = 8, radius = 8, fill = C.button, hover_fill = C.button_hover, press_scale = 0.97,
    ui.text({ label, color = C.text, font_size = 14, no_wrap = true }),
    on_click = on_click,
  })
end

return function()
  local lab = {
    id = "lab", width = W, height = H, radius = 10,
    gravity = state.g,
    wells = state.well and { { at = { 490, 330 }, radius = 200, pull = 1700 } } or {},
    joints = joints(),
    on_drag = on_drag, on_zone = on_zone, on_timer = on_timer, on_hit = on_hit,
  }
  for _, e in ipairs(build()) do lab[#lab + 1] = e end

  return ui.col({
    full = true, center = true, gap = 10, fill = C.bg,
    ui.row({
      gap = 28, align_center = true,
      ui.text({ "SIEGE", color = C.accent, font_size = 20, no_wrap = true }),
      ui.text({ "score " .. state.score, id = "score", color = C.text, font_size = 16, no_wrap = true }),
      ui.text({ state.status, id = "status", color = C.muted, font_size = 14, no_wrap = true }),
    }),
    ui.world(lab),
    ui.row({
      gap = 10,
      button("swing", "Swing", function() world("lab"):push(N("bob"), { 520, -60 }) state.status = "Wrecking ball!" end),
      button("bomb", "Bomb", function() world("lab"):blast({ 486, 400 }, { speed = 620, radius = 200 }) state.status = "BOOM" end),
      button("gravity", "Gravity: " .. state.gname, cycle_gravity),
      button("well", state.well and "Well: on" or "Well: off", function()
        state.well = not state.well
        state.status = state.well and "Gravity well pulls on the castle" or "Well closed"
      end),
      button("reset", "Reset", reset),
    }),
  })
end

local C = require("theme")
local V = require("voronoi")
local M = require("model")

local KAPPA = 0.5522847498307933

local function poly_path(poly, ox, oy)
  local cmds = { { "move", poly[1][1] - ox, poly[1][2] - oy } }
  for i = 2, #poly do
    cmds[i] = { "line", poly[i][1] - ox, poly[i][2] - oy }
  end
  cmds[#cmds + 1] = { "close" }
  return gfx.path(cmds)
end

local function circle_path(cx, cy, r)
  local k = r * KAPPA
  return gfx.path({
    { "move", cx + r, cy },
    { "cubic", cx + r, cy + k, cx + k, cy + r, cx, cy + r },
    { "cubic", cx - k, cy + r, cx - r, cy + k, cx - r, cy },
    { "cubic", cx - r, cy - k, cx - k, cy - r, cx, cy - r },
    { "cubic", cx + k, cy - r, cx + r, cy - k, cx + r, cy },
    { "close" },
  })
end

local function on_hover(e)
  local phase, shape, sx, sy = e.phase, e.shape, e.sx, e.sy
  if phase == "leave" then
    M.hit = nil
  else
    M.hit = shape and { shape = shape, sx = sx, sy = sy } or nil
  end
end

-- A drag past the press slop cancels the click, so selection and dragging share the frame without
-- a guard between them.
local function on_drag(e)
  local phase, x, y, dx, dy, scale, origin_x, origin_y, shape, sx, sy = e.phase, e.x, e.y, e.dx, e.dy, e.scale, e.origin_x, e.origin_y, e.shape, e.sx, e.sy
  if phase == "start" then
    M.grab(shape, sx, sy)
  end
  M.drag_to(x, y)
  if phase == "end" then
    M.drag = nil
  end
end

local function on_click(e)
  local i = M.index_of(e.shape)
  M.sel = M.sel ~= i and i or nil
end

local function label(text, color, size)
  return ui.text({ text, color = color, font_size = size, no_wrap = true })
end

local function readout(live_name)
  local d = M.drag
  if d then
    local s = M.sites[d.i]
    return string.format(
      "holding %s   site (%.0f, %.0f)   grabbed at sx %.1f  sy %.1f   pointer over %s",
      d.shape,
      s.x,
      s.y,
      d.sx,
      d.sy,
      live_name
    )
  end

  local h = M.hit
  if not h then
    return "hover a cell"
  end
  local s = M.sites[M.index_of(h.shape)]
  return string.format(
    "%s   site (%.0f, %.0f)   sx %.1f  sy %.1f",
    h.shape,
    s.x,
    s.y,
    h.sx,
    h.sy
  )
end

return function()
  local sites = M.sites
  local cells = V.cells(sites, C.w, C.h)

  -- The frame's own hit test, which is resampled every frame — so the lit cell follows a drifting
  -- diagram under a still pointer without a second copy of the pick math living here.
  local hot_kind, hot_i
  if M.hit then
    hot_kind, hot_i = M.hit.shape:match("^(%a+):(%d+)")
    hot_i = tonumber(hot_i)
  end

  -- Each cell is drawn in its own site's frame, so the pointer reports sx, sy as an offset from
  -- that site instead of repeating the frame coordinates it already gets as x, y.
  local items, paths, live = { width = C.w, height = C.h }, {}, 0
  for i = 1, #cells do
    local poly = cells[i]
    if #poly >= 3 then
      live = live + 1
      local s = sites[i]
      paths[i] = poly_path(poly, s.x, s.y)
      local lit = hot_kind == "cell" and hot_i == i
      items[#items + 1] = gfx.group({
        id = "cell:" .. i,
        transform = { 1, 0, 0, 1, s.x, s.y },
        gfx.fill({
          path = paths[i],
          brush = gfx.solid(lit and C.cells_hot[i] or C.cells[i]),
        }),
        gfx.stroke({
          path = paths[i],
          brush = gfx.solid(C.edge),
          width = C.edge_w,
        }),
      })
    end
  end

  -- the halo rides an unnamed group so it paints over every cell without claiming the pointer
  if M.sel and paths[M.sel] then
    items[#items + 1] = gfx.group({
      transform = { 1, 0, 0, 1, sites[M.sel].x, sites[M.sel].y },
      gfx.stroke({
        path = paths[M.sel],
        brush = gfx.solid(C.halo),
        width = C.halo_w,
        join = "round",
      }),
    })
  end

  -- dots last: where two named shapes overlap, the later one answers the pointer.
  -- Each is a named group holding one dot drawn at the origin, so the pointer reports
  -- sx, sy as an offset from its site rather than as frame coordinates again.
  local rim, rim_brush = circle_path(0, 0, C.site_hit), gfx.solid(C.site_rim)
  local core, core_brush = circle_path(0, 0, C.site_r), gfx.solid(C.site_core)
  local core_lit, core_lit_brush = circle_path(0, 0, C.site_r + 1.5), gfx.solid(C.site_core_hot)
  for i = 1, #sites do
    local s = sites[i]
    local lit = hot_kind == "site" and hot_i == i
    items[#items + 1] = gfx.group({
      id = "site:" .. i,
      transform = { 1, 0, 0, 1, s.x, s.y },
      gfx.fill({ path = rim, brush = rim_brush }),
      gfx.fill({
        path = lit and core_lit or core,
        brush = lit and core_lit_brush or core_brush,
      }),
    })
  end

  local canvas = {
    id = "canvas",
    visual = gfx.frame(items),
    on_hover = on_hover,
    on_click = on_click,
    on_drag = on_drag,
  }
  if not M.paused then
    canvas.on_frame = M.step
  end

  local live_name = hot_kind and (hot_kind .. ":" .. hot_i) or "nothing"

  return ui.col({
    id = "voronoi",
    grow = true,
    fill = C.bg,
    pad = 20,
    gap = 14,
    align_center = true,
    ui.row({
      w = C.w,
      gap = 12,
      align_center = true,
      label("Voronoi", C.text, 16),
      label("every cell is clipped out of the rectangle, this frame — drag a site", C.dim, 12),
      ui.col({ grow = true }),
      label(live .. " / " .. #sites .. " cells", C.dim, 12),
      ui.button({
        id = "pause",
        h = 28,
        px = 12,
        radius = 7,
        center = true,
        fill = C.accent,
        hover_fill = C.accent_hot,
        press_scale = 0.96,
        label(M.paused and "Resume" or "Pause", "#ffffff", 12),
        on_click = function()
          M.paused = not M.paused
        end,
      }),
    }),
    ui.frame(canvas),
    ui.col({
      w = C.w,
      gap = 4,
      label(readout(live_name), C.text, 12),
      label(
        M.sel and ("selected cell:" .. M.sel .. " — click it again to clear")
          or "click to select a cell; drag a site, or anywhere in a cell, to move it",
        C.dim,
        12
      ),
    }),
  })
end

local C = require("theme")

local M = {
  sites = {},
  paused = false,
  sel = nil,
  hit = nil,
  drag = nil,
}

local seeds = {
  { 110, 92, 1, 0.4 },
  { 302, 58, -0.6, 1 },
  { 524, 124, 0.3, -1 },
  { 688, 74, -1, 0.5 },
  { 158, 302, 0.8, -0.7 },
  { 382, 248, -0.4, -1 },
  { 598, 340, 1, 0.2 },
  { 700, 398, -0.9, -0.6 },
}

for i, s in ipairs(seeds) do
  local len = math.sqrt(s[3] * s[3] + s[4] * s[4])
  M.sites[i] = { x = s[1], y = s[2], dx = s[3] / len, dy = s[4] / len }
end

function M.step(e)
  local dt, elapsed = e.dt, e.elapsed
  local hi_x, hi_y = C.w - C.margin, C.h - C.margin
  local held = M.drag and M.drag.i
  for i = 1, #M.sites do
    local s = M.sites[i]
    if i ~= held then
      local turn = math.sin(elapsed * 0.27 + i * 1.7) * C.swirl * dt
      local c, n = math.cos(turn), math.sin(turn)
      s.dx, s.dy = c * s.dx - n * s.dy, n * s.dx + c * s.dy
      s.x = s.x + s.dx * C.speed * dt
      s.y = s.y + s.dy * C.speed * dt
      if s.x < C.margin then
        s.x, s.dx = C.margin, -s.dx
      elseif s.x > hi_x then
        s.x, s.dx = hi_x, -s.dx
      end
      if s.y < C.margin then
        s.y, s.dy = C.margin, -s.dy
      elseif s.y > hi_y then
        s.y, s.dy = hi_y, -s.dy
      end
    end
  end
end

-- Both kinds of shape are drawn in their site's own frame, so the press's `sx, sy` is the grab
-- offset from that site either way. Keeping it from the press is the whole trick: the live
-- `sx, sy` is measured against the transform the shape had when it was grabbed, so it drifts by
-- exactly the distance dragged and cannot be used as an offset a second time.
function M.grab(shape, sx, sy)
  local i = M.index_of(shape)
  M.drag = i and { i = i, shape = shape, sx = sx, sy = sy } or nil
end

function M.drag_to(x, y)
  local d = M.drag
  if not d then
    return
  end
  local s = M.sites[d.i]
  s.x = math.max(C.margin, math.min(C.w - C.margin, x - d.sx))
  s.y = math.max(C.margin, math.min(C.h - C.margin, y - d.sy))
end

function M.index_of(shape)
  return shape and tonumber(shape:match(":(%d+)$"))
end

return M

local M = {}

-- Sutherland-Hodgman against one half-plane: keep the part of `poly` at least as close to `a`
-- as to `b`, i.e. where d·p <= d·m for d = b - a and m the midpoint of ab.
local function clip(poly, a, b)
  local dx, dy = b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y
  local c = dx * (a.x + b.x) * 0.5 + dy * (a.y + b.y) * 0.5
  local out, n = {}, #poly
  for i = 1, n do
    local p, q = poly[i], poly[i % n + 1]
    local dp = dx * p[1] + dy * p[2] - c
    local dq = dx * q[1] + dy * q[2] - c
    if dp <= 0 then
      out[#out + 1] = p
    end
    -- only a strict crossing makes a new vertex; a vertex on the line is already in `out`
    if (dp < 0 and dq > 0) or (dp > 0 and dq < 0) then
      local t = dp / (dp - dq)
      out[#out + 1] = { p[1] + t * (q[1] - p[1]), p[2] + t * (q[2] - p[2]) }
    end
  end
  return out
end

function M.cell(sites, i, w, h)
  local a = sites[i]
  local poly = { { 0, 0 }, { w, 0 }, { w, h }, { 0, h } }
  for j = 1, #sites do
    local b = sites[j]
    if j ~= i then
      if b.x == a.x and b.y == a.y then
        -- coincident sites have no bisector; the lower index keeps the cell so the
        -- cells still tile instead of two of them claiming the same ground
        if j < i then
          return {}
        end
      else
        poly = clip(poly, a, b)
        if #poly < 3 then
          return poly
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return poly
end

function M.cells(sites, w, h)
  local out = {}
  for i = 1, #sites do
    out[i] = M.cell(sites, i, w, h)
  end
  return out
end

function M.area(poly)
  local a, n = 0, #poly
  for i = 1, n do
    local p, q = poly[i], poly[i % n + 1]
    a = a + p[1] * q[2] - q[1] * p[2]
  end
  return a * 0.5
end

function M.nearest(sites, x, y)
  local best, d2 = 1, math.huge
  for i = 1, #sites do
    local dx, dy = x - sites[i].x, y - sites[i].y
    local d = dx * dx + dy * dy
    if d < d2 then
      best, d2 = i, d
    end
  end
  return best
end

function M.contains(poly, x, y)
  local n = #poly
  for i = 1, n do
    local p, q = poly[i], poly[i % n + 1]
    if (q[1] - p[1]) * (y - p[2]) - (q[2] - p[2]) * (x - p[1]) < 0 then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

return M

-- Physics playground: a top-down table where Rapier does all the moving. Lua describes bodies,
-- hears pockets and drags, and commands velocities; nothing runs per frame. The world has no
-- gravity, so "falling" is a launched velocity and pegs are fixed colliders.
local C = {
  bg = "#12131c", felt = "#1f5c46", rim = "#4a2f1d", pocket = "#0a0b10", peg = "#e9a23b",
  cue = "#f4f1e8", text = "#e7e9f3", muted = "#8a8fa8", button = "#2c3048", button_hover = "#3a3f5e",
  aim = "#f4f1e8",
}
local W, H, T = 880, 500, 14 -- the table, wall thickness
local POCKET = 30
local CUE_POS = { 150, H / 2 - 14 }

-- Park-Miller, so a recording of the same clicks is the same chaos.
local seed = 20261018
local function rnd()
  seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647
  return seed / 2147483647
end

local function disc(r, fill, stroke)
  local k = r * 0.5523
  return { path = { {"move",0,r}, {"cubic",0,r-k,r-k,0,r,0}, {"cubic",r+k,0,2*r,r-k,2*r,r},
    {"cubic",2*r,r+k,r+k,2*r,r,2*r}, {"cubic",r-k,2*r,0,r+k,0,r}, {"close"} },
    fill = fill, stroke = stroke }
end
local function rect(w, h, fill)
  return { path = { {"move",0,0}, {"line",w,0}, {"line",w,h}, {"line",0,h}, {"close"} }, fill = fill }
end
local function drawing(w, h, shapes)
  return gfx.drawing({ size = { w, h }, parts = { { id = "it", pivot = { w / 2, h / 2 }, shapes = shapes } } })
end

-- A ball carries a light tick so its spin is visible; drawings are made once per size and colour.
local balls_cache = {}
local function ball_drawing(r, fill)
  local key = r .. fill
  if not balls_cache[key] then
    local tick = { path = { {"move",r-1.5,2}, {"line",r+1.5,2}, {"line",r+1.5,r*0.7}, {"line",r-1.5,r*0.7},
      {"close"} }, fill = "#ffffff55" }
    balls_cache[key] = drawing(2 * r, 2 * r, { disc(r, fill, { 1.5, "#00000055" }), tick })
  end
  return balls_cache[key]
end

local KINDS = {
  { r = 9, bounce = 0.98, friction = 0.08, colors = { "#ff6b6b", "#ffd166", "#ff9f43" } }, -- quick and bouncy
  { r = 14, bounce = 0.85, friction = 0.25, colors = { "#4dabf7", "#63e6be", "#b197fc" } },
  { r = 22, bounce = 0.45, friction = 0.8, colors = { "#868e96", "#5c677d" } }, -- heavy, dies fast
}

local function block(id, x, y, w, h)
  return { id = id, pos = { x, y }, drawing = drawing(w, h, { rect(w, h, C.rim) }), collider = { rect = { w, h } } }
end
local function peg(id, cx, cy, r)
  return { id = id, pos = { cx - r, cy - r }, drawing = drawing(2 * r, 2 * r, { disc(r, C.peg, { 3, "#fff3" }) }),
    collider = { circle = r, at = { r, r } } }
end
-- Corner pockets: the sensor reaches past the drawn hole so a ball at the wall still counts.
local function pocket(id, cx, cy)
  local R = POCKET
  return { id = id, pos = { cx - R, cy - R }, drawing = drawing(2 * R, 2 * R, { disc(R, C.pocket) }),
    sensor = { circle = R + 8, at = { R, R } } }
end

local balls = {} -- { id, x, y, r, bounce, friction, color }
local launches = {} -- { id, vx, vy }, set once the entities exist
local serial = 0
local pocketed, scratches = 0, 0
local aim = nil -- { x, y } where the cue was grabbed

local function add_ball(kind, x, y, color)
  serial = serial + 1
  local id = "b" .. serial
  balls[#balls + 1] = { id = id, x = x, y = y, r = kind.r, bounce = kind.bounce, friction = kind.friction,
    color = color or kind.colors[1 + math.floor(rnd() * #kind.colors)] }
  return id
end

local function clear()
  balls, launches, pocketed, scratches = {}, {}, 0, 0
  world("table"):cancel("launch")
end

-- Fifteen same-size balls in a triangle: one break shot scatters them.
local function rack()
  clear()
  local kind = KINDS[2]
  local d = 2 * kind.r + 1
  local palette = { "#ff6b6b", "#ffd166", "#4dabf7", "#63e6be", "#b197fc", "#ff9f43", "#f783ac" }
  for row = 0, 4 do
    for i = 0, row do
      local n = #balls
      add_ball(kind, 640 + row * d * 0.87, H / 2 - row * d / 2 + i * d - kind.r, palette[1 + n % #palette])
    end
  end
  world("table"):set("cue", { pos = CUE_POS, velocity = { 0, 0 } })
end

-- A volley from the top edge, aimed down at the pegs: mixed sizes, speeds and bounce.
local function burst()
  for i = 0, 13 do
    local kind = KINDS[1 + math.floor(rnd() * #KINDS)]
    local id = add_ball(kind, 250 + (i % 7) * 60, 40 + math.floor(i / 7) * 50)
    launches[#launches + 1] = { id = id, vx = (rnd() - 0.5) * 500, vy = 350 + rnd() * 450 }
  end
  world("table"):after(0.03, "launch")
end

local function button(id, label, on_click)
  return ui.button({
    id = id, px = 18, py = 9, radius = 8, fill = C.button, hover_fill = C.button_hover, press_scale = 0.97,
    ui.text({ label, color = C.text, font_size = 14, no_wrap = true }),
    on_click = on_click,
  })
end

local PIPS = 6
local function hide_aim()
  aim = nil
  for i = 1, PIPS do world("table"):set("pip" .. i, { pos = { -50, -50 } }) end
end

local pip = drawing(8, 8, { disc(4, C.aim) })

return function()
  local entities = {
    block("wall:top", 0, 0, W, T), block("wall:bottom", 0, H - T, W, T),
    block("wall:left", 0, 0, T, H), block("wall:right", W - T, 0, T, H),
    pocket("pocket:tl", 0, 0), pocket("pocket:tr", W, 0), pocket("pocket:bl", 0, H), pocket("pocket:br", W, H),
    peg("peg:mid", 440, 260, 26), peg("peg:tl", 350, 200, 18), peg("peg:tr", 530, 200, 18),
    peg("peg:bl", 350, 320, 18), peg("peg:br", 530, 320, 18),
    { id = "cue", pos = CUE_POS, drawing = ball_drawing(14, C.cue),
      collider = { circle = 14, at = { 14, 14 } }, loose = { bounce = 0.92, friction = 0.3, grip = 0.25 } },
  }
  for _, b in ipairs(balls) do
    entities[#entities + 1] = { id = b.id, pos = { b.x - b.r, b.y - b.r }, drawing = ball_drawing(b.r, b.color),
      collider = { circle = b.r, at = { b.r, b.r } }, loose = { bounce = b.bounce, friction = b.friction, grip = 0.2 } }
  end
  for i = 1, PIPS do entities[#entities + 1] = { id = "pip" .. i, pos = { -50, -50 }, drawing = pip } end

  local table_el = {
    id = "table", width = W, height = H, fill = C.felt, radius = 10, stroke = { 3, C.rim },
    on_zone = function(e)
      if e.phase ~= "enter" then return end
      if e.who == "cue" then
        scratches = scratches + 1
        world("table"):set("cue", { pos = CUE_POS, velocity = { 0, 0 } })
        return
      end
      for i, b in ipairs(balls) do
        if b.id == e.who then
          table.remove(balls, i)
          pocketed = pocketed + 1
          break
        end
      end
    end,
    on_timer = function(e)
      if e.name ~= "launch" then return end
      for _, l in ipairs(launches) do world("table"):set(l.id, { velocity = { l.vx, l.vy } }) end
      launches = {}
    end,
    -- Pull the cue back like a slingshot: dots show the line it will take.
    on_drag = function(e)
      if e.phase == "start" then
        aim = e.shape == "cue" and { x = e.x, y = e.y } or nil
        return
      end
      if not aim then return end
      local px, py = aim.x - e.x, aim.y - e.y
      if e.phase == "move" then
        for i = 1, PIPS do
          world("table"):set("pip" .. i, { pos = { aim.x + px * i / PIPS - 4, aim.y + py * i / PIPS - 4 } })
        end
      else
        local len = math.sqrt(px * px + py * py)
        local k = len > 1400 / 6 and 1400 / len or 6
        if len > 6 then world("table"):set("cue", { velocity = { px * k, py * k } }) end
        hide_aim()
      end
    end,
  }
  for _, en in ipairs(entities) do table_el[#table_el + 1] = en end

  return ui.col({
    full = true, center = true, gap = 12, fill = C.bg,
    ui.row({
      gap = 24, align_center = true,
      ui.text({ "Physics playground", color = C.text, font_size = 22, no_wrap = true }),
      ui.text({ "pocketed " .. pocketed .. " · scratches " .. scratches, id = "score", color = C.muted,
        font_size = 14, no_wrap = true }),
    }),
    ui.world(table_el),
    ui.row({
      gap = 12,
      button("rack", "Rack", rack),
      button("burst", "Burst", burst),
      button("clear", "Clear", clear),
    }),
  })
end

-- stats.lua: tasks by priority, drawn straight from the document.
local C = { card = "#161b22", line = "#30363d", text = "#e6edf3", muted = "#8b949e" }
local COLOR = { high = "#f85149", med = "#d29922", low = "#3fb950" }
local W, H = 150, 12
local M = {}

local bars = {}
local function bar(done, total, peak, color)
  local key = done .. ":" .. total .. ":" .. peak .. color
  if not bars[key] then
    local function rect(w)
      return gfx.path({ { "move", 0, 0 }, { "line", w, 0 }, { "line", w, H }, { "line", 0, H }, { "close" } })
    end
    local items = { gfx.fill({ path = rect(W), brush = gfx.solid(C.line) }) }
    if total > 0 then
      table.insert(items, gfx.fill({ path = rect(W * total / peak), brush = gfx.solid("#30363d") }))
      table.insert(items, gfx.fill({ path = rect(math.max(1, W * done / peak)), brush = gfx.solid(color) }))
    end
    items.width, items.height = W, H
    bars[key] = gfx.frame(items)
  end
  return bars[key]
end

function M.view(tasks)
  local count = { high = { 0, 0 }, med = { 0, 0 }, low = { 0, 0 } } -- { done, total }
  for _, task in ipairs(tasks) do
    local c = count[task.prio]
    if c then
      c[2] = c[2] + 1
      if task.done then c[1] = c[1] + 1 end
    end
  end
  local peak = 1
  for _, c in pairs(count) do peak = math.max(peak, c[2]) end

  local cells = {}
  for _, p in ipairs({ "high", "med", "low" }) do
    local done, total = count[p][1], count[p][2]
    table.insert(cells, ui.col({
      gap = 6,
      ui.row({
        gap = 6, align_center = true,
        ui.text({ p, color = COLOR[p], font_size = 12, no_wrap = true }),
        ui.col({ grow = true }),
        ui.text({ done .. "/" .. total, color = C.muted, font_size = 12, no_wrap = true }),
      }),
      ui.frame({ visual = bar(done, total, peak, COLOR[p]) }),
    }))
  end
  return ui.col({
    gap = 10, pad = 14, radius = 10, fill = C.card, stroke = { 1, C.line },
    ui.text({ "By priority", color = C.text, font_size = 13, no_wrap = true }),
    ui.row({ gap = 28, cells }),
  })
end

return M
